evidence_items.explanation: The study ran each task four times and reported substantial failures, with repeated-success scores declining as more successful trials were required. This supports the reliability concern in the tested customer-service tasks, without establishing that all LLM uses fail.

evidence_items.locator: Section Advancing the frontiers in mathematics and algorithm discovery
evidence_items.explanation: The announcement describes Gemini-generated programs combined with evolutionary search and automated verification producing previously unknown mathematical constructions. This contradicts the ordinary blanket denial of useful novelty, subject to the distinction between a new construction and a fundamental new concept.

evidence_items.locator: Paragraph beginning There had been no movement
evidence_items.explanation: An external university account recognizes AlphaEvolve's improved bound while discussing competing human mathematical work. It corroborates that the result advanced existing knowledge, although it does not document a fresh replication of the complete discovery process.

evidence_items.locator: Section 1, Introduction, before the contributions list
evidence_items.explanation: This GUI-testing study reports high execution consistency for one tested model with guardrails. It limits generalization from failure-heavy benchmarks, but does not establish dependable performance across all tasks.

unresolved_gaps: The evidence does not settle whether a new mathematical construction satisfies the speaker's intended meaning of novel concepts.
No representative evaluation establishes one reliability rate across all models and applications.
These studies do not isolate probabilistic generation as the sole cause of the observed failures.
